name: aec-daily-briefing
description: Daily AEC news briefing from national and international sources, saved to Notion

payload.message: Run the aec-news-daily-skill: Fetch all AEC news sources (RSS feeds and scrape non-RSS sites via Apify MCP), select top stories from past 24 hours, generate structured daily briefing in Portuguese (pt-BR), save all results to Notion AEC News Feed database, and create a Daily Overview page titled 'AEC Briefing - {today}' with the full briefing content.

_manual_trigger.description: To run this task manually, paste the message below into your AI assistant chat:
_manual_trigger.message: Run the aec-news-daily-skill: Fetch all AEC news sources (RSS feeds and scrape non-RSS sites via Apify MCP), select top stories from past 24 hours, generate structured daily briefing in Portuguese (pt-BR), save all results to Notion AEC News Feed database, and create a Daily Overview page titled 'AEC Briefing - {today}' with the full briefing content.
